facts.fact: The World Bank's appraisal of May 2024 says most services at the 15 County Service Centers, whose services include birth registration for ages 0-12 and birth certificates, remain paper-based and need further processing in Monrovia, with records not digitalised and documents physically moved between the centres and Monrovia; the statement covers the centres' services generally and is not made of birth registration alone, and the appraisal's date is used.
facts.system: civil registry maintained by the Ministry of Health and Social Welfare; birth registration at County Service Centers

facts.fact: The World Bank's appraisal of May 2024 says the civil registry, holding birth, marriage and death information, is maintained by the Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, separately from the National Identification Registry.
facts.system: civil registry maintained by the Ministry of Health and Social Welfare

facts.fact: The World Bank's US$30 million GREAT credit, appraised May 2024, is to finance technical assistance and ICT to re-engineer government services with a focus on birth and death registration (within a US$6.0 million subcomponent), and new online services for registration at birth through the civil registry, reachable countrywide through County Service Centers; these are planned activities and no domestic budget line is stated.
facts.system: civil registry maintained by the Ministry of Health and Social Welfare
